checklist_requirement: Identify the report as a systematic review.
Provide an explicit statement of the main objective(s) or question(s).
Specify inclusion and exclusion criteria for the review.
Specify the information sources and the last search date for each.
Specify methods used to assess risk of bias in included studies.
Specify the methods used to present and synthesise results.
Give the total number of included studies and participants, and summarise relevant characteristics.

Present results for the main outcomes, preferably indicating the number of studies and participants for each; when meta-analysis was done, report the summary estimate and its precision, and direction of effect.
Provide a brief summary of limitations of the evidence (e.g., risk of bias, inconsistency, imprecision).
Provide a general interpretation of the results and important implications.
Specify the primary source of funding for the review.
Provide the register name and registration number.
